items.caption: A received seal-style form of 干 has a tall central stroke crossing a broad horizontal stroke, with a curved, open upper section.
items.alt: Black seal-style 干 glyph with a long vertical stroke, a broad crossbar, and a curved forked top.
items.selection_reason: The visible redraw usefully shows the received seal-style form. It illustrates a later form, while the earliest secure attestation and the proposed earlier Shang forms have separate dating limits.

limitations.text: This modern redraw illustrates a received seal-style form; it is not a dated artifact and cannot establish the shield interpretation, earliest attestation, or a complete graphic lineage. Some proposed Shang identifications remain disputed.
